**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Treat the inadmissible arms as inconclusive**

After the immutability fix, the fresh current text still calls `guard-fails-open` a sweep effect and later reports `Precision regression result: NOT REGRESSED`, even though this document explicitly concludes that the arms are not an admissible same-configuration comparison and cannot establish an effect. Without evidence that both arms used the same immutable model artifact, model drift can explain any between-arm difference; retain the raw observations, but report the recall, variance, latency, and precision comparisons as inconclusive until the endpoint pin is attested.
